legend: Dreamoon loves summing up something for no reason. One day he obtains two integers a and b occasionally. He wants to calculate the sum of all nice integers. Positive integer x is called nice if ![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/747b668d05dce59a14c79f7573cf84d4af25536c.png) and ![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/f2c3c9a716cef71591af317f816d0d89605de8cd.png), where k is some integer number in range [1, a].

By ![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/1e6fb3a33a9e71aae77ea40b847b4751cad6a9b2.png) we denote the quotient of integer division of x and y. By ![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/13ccd3404ca33681bef79230f269517728677a3a.png) we denote the remainder of integer division of x and y. You can read more about these operations here: http://goo.gl/AcsXhT.
The answer may be large, so please print its remainder modulo 1 000 000 007 (109 + 7). Can you compute it faster than Dreamoon?
input: The single line of the input contains two integers a, b (1 ≤ a, b ≤ 107).
output: Print a single integer representing the answer modulo 1 000 000 007 (109 + 7).
note: For the first sample, there are no nice integers because ![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/03b1dc6bae5180f8a2d8eb85789e8b393e585970.png) is always zero.
For the second sample, the set of nice integers is {3, 5}.

output.ai: 输出一个整数，表示答案对 1 000 000 007 (109 + 7) 取模的结果。

note.ai: 对于第一个样例，不存在漂亮整数，因为 ![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/03b1dc6bae5180f8a2d8eb85789e8b393e585970.png) 始终为零。
对于第二个样例，漂亮整数的集合为 {3, 5}。

legend.ai: Dreamoon 喜欢毫无理由地进行求和。一天，他偶然得到两个整数 a 和 b。他想计算所有优美整数的总和。如果 ![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/747b668d05dce59a14c79f7573cf84d4af25536c.png) 且 ![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/f2c3c9a716cef71591af317f816d0d89605de8cd.png)，其中 k 是范围在 [1, a] 内的某个整数，则称正整数 x 是优美的。

用 ![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/1e6fb3a33a9e71aae77ea40b847b4751cad6a9b2.png) 表示 x 除以 y 的整数除法所得的商。用 ![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/13ccd3404ca33681bef79230f269517728677a3a.png) 表示 x 除以 y 的整数除法所得的余数。你可以在这里阅读有关这些运算的更多信息：http://goo.gl/AcsXhT.
答案可能很大，因此请输出其对 1 000 000 007（109 + 7）取模后的余数。你能比 Dreamoon 更快地计算出答案吗？

input.ai: 输入的单行包含两个整数 a、b（1 ≤ a，b ≤ 107）。
